answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using Proof of Space-Time audits. At the dawn of each round, nodes must prove they harbor unique, non-compressible storage plots, clearing a strict capacity ledge to participate. An attacker incurs the verifiable expense of provisioning dedicated high-speed drive sectors and read bandwidth per identity. However, this mechanism penalizes resource-light edge agents and favors data centers with surplus disk capacity.
